test_HermesCLI_process_command: test the HermesCLI.process_command method for slash command prefix matching behavior
test_unique_prefix_dispatch: test that /con uniquely dispatches to /config when it is the only matching command
test_prefix_with_args_no_recursion: test that /con set key value expands to /config set key value without infinite recursion
test_exact_command_no_recursion: test that /config set key value hits the exact branch and does not loop back to prefix matching
test_ambiguous_prefix_suggestions: test that /re shows an ambiguous message when it matches multiple commands
test_unknown_command_error: test that /xyz shows an unknown command error message
test_skill_command_prefix_match: test that a prefix uniquely matching a skill command dispatches to that skill
test_shortest_match_preferred: test that /qui dispatches to /quit instead of being ambiguous with /quint-pipeline
